title: Internal: Managing Debit Card Security Alerts and Blocks
summary: This document explains how to manage debit card security alerts and temporary blocks: fraud alerts (customer-initiated vs bank-initiated) and velocity blocks. It notes velocity blocks expire after 30 minutes and can be cleared earlier after identity verification using tool clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892. Bank-initiated fraud alerts cannot be cleared and must be escalated to the security team.
faqs: What are the differences between customer-initiated and bank-initiated fraud alerts for debit cards?
